title: Multiplayer Trace bid choices are side-safe
steps: A private multiplayer match is prepared at Corp Trace bid.
Only Corp sees the Corp bid PendingChoice.
Corp submits bid_1 with idempotency key.
Only Runner sees the Runner bid PendingChoice after reconnect.
Runner submits bid_0 and Trace succeeds.
Undo request against the public Runner bid event is accepted.
